name: Pinball Arcade: Junk Yard
storyline: Junk Yard (1996) is billed as The Meanest Game in the Whole Darn Town. Designed by Barry Oursler and Dwight Sullivan, this table challenges players to escape Crazy Bobs Junk Yard. This is accomplished by collecting pieces of Junk to build various contraptions, going on wild Adventures and ultimately launching into Outer Space to take on Crazy Bob. The Playfield has many great features including the Great Toilet, the Magic Bus, mean old Spike the dog and a moving Crane. Its not hard to play in the yard. 3,013 units of this table were produced.
